about.en: Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group, Inc. is a Japanese financial holding company whose group companies include MUFG Bank, Mitsubishi UFJ Trust and Banking, Mitsubishi UFJ Securities Holdings, Bank of Ayudhya (Krungsri) and Bank Danamon. 8306 represents its common shares listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, which derivative markets quote under the JPMUFG ticker, and is distinct from the American depositary shares traded on the NYSE under MUFG.
